headline: Check South Unit Scenic Loop and Campground Status
reservation: No park-wide entry permit is required, but campgrounds like Cottonwood and Juniper use the Recreation.gov system. Reservations for Medora-based lodging and seasonal musicals should be made months ahead for summer. Check official NPS alerts for road segments currently closed due to erosion.

days.title: South Unit Badlands Introduction

stops.name: Painted Canyon Overlook
stops.detail: View the vibrant layers of the North Dakota badlands directly from the visitor center area.

stops.name: Maltese Cross Cabin
stops.detail: Explore the original log cabin used by Theodore Roosevelt during his ranching years.

days.driving: Allow 1 hour for local roads; check for loop closures.
days.note: Maintain a safe distance of at least 25 yards from roaming bison.

days.title: High Plateaus and Prairie Dogs

stops.name: Wind Canyon Trail
stops.detail: Take a short walk for views overlooking the Little Missouri River and silty badlands.

stops.name: Buck Hill
stops.detail: Ascend to one of the highest points in the park for a 360-degree regional perspective.

days.driving: Allow 2 hours for leisurely sightseeing and wildlife stops.
days.note: Trails may be impassable and slippery immediately following rain.

days.title: The North Unit Wilderness

stops.name: River Bend Overlook
stops.detail: View the CCC-built stone shelter and a sweeping bend of the river below.

stops.name: Oxbow Overlook
stops.detail: Observe the geological forces at work at the end of the North Unit scenic drive.

days.driving: Allow 1.5 hours to transfer between units; conditions vary.
days.note: The North and South units are in different time zones (Mountain vs Central).

intel.title: Overlook Capacity
intel.text: Parking at popular spots like Wind Canyon is limited and may fill by midday in July. Use designated paved lots only to protect fragile prairie grasses.

intel.title: Siloed Service
intel.text: Cellular reception is generally available in Medora but fails once inside the badlands canyons. Carry physical maps for navigation between the North and South units.

intel.title: Gateway Gas
intel.text: Fuel services are located in Medora and Watford City but are non-existent within park boundaries. Top off your tank before starting the 70-mile drive between units.

intel.title: Wildlife Watching
intel.text: Bison and wild horses are most active during the cooler morning and evening hours. Plan drives during these times for the best viewing opportunities from your vehicle.

intel.title: Road Stability
intel.text: The South Unit scenic loop is frequently subject to closures due to bentonite clay shifts. Check the official NPS 'Conditions' page daily for route updates.

plan.arrival: Fly into Dickinson (DIK), drive 40 minutes to Medora, and stop at the South Unit Visitor Center for current trail conditions.
plan.vehicle: Standard passenger cars are sufficient for paved scenic drives; check for seasonal snow tire requirements in winter.
plan.goldenHour: Oxbow Overlook provides expansive views for sunset, though lighting depends on seasonal cloud cover over the river.
